g.text: Pin 2 = board GND; pin 6 = GNDI2C. Same VSS inside module.

g.text: ADDR is configured on each module, not by this carrier PCB.

g.desc: ADDR is configured on each module, not by this carrier PCB.

g.text: C5: ceramic, non-polar. C7: electrolytic, + to 5V.

g.text: MCP4725 VCC = 3.3 V ONLY; J8 feeds IR, J9 feeds RED.

g.text: For RED: remove the old ADDR-GND bridge before selecting VCC.

g.text: GNDI2C_x has no PCB copper to GND; joined only inside its module.
